messages:
maria (platform): starting v2 rollout to eu-central-1 in the 2h change window. plan: 0.5% canary for 20m -> 5% -> 20% if green. release notes live.

deploy-bot: deploy started: service=api-gateway target=v2 region=eu-central-1 canary=0.5% window=20m id=deploy-6311239999

tom (runtime): FYI we added a new optional field `meta.source_id` in v2 responses. it should be optional but there
re reports of strict parsers choking on trailing commas in streamed chunks.

jen (ops): getting a couple of client reports about truncated streams and client-side parse errors. not widespread yet but correlated to canary.

sriniv (sre): alert: streaming-error-rate has risen from 0.02% -> 0.9% on the canary shard. sampling logs now.

tom (runtime): past run logs show chunk framing included a trailing comma in some edge cases when `meta.source_id` is absent. that's our bug.

maria (platform): options: abort rollout and rollback to v1, or steer traffic off v2 for affected tenants and hotpatch runtime to fix trailing commas. prefer non-rollback if we can isolate tenants quickly.

jen (ops): we can pin specific enterprise tenants back to v1 using tenant-pin command. i recommend steering until hotpatch lands.


deploy-bot: recommended action: `tenant-pin --region eu-central-1 --tenants tenant:acme,tenant:betacorp --target v1` and `shift-weight --from v2 --to v1 --percent 80 --region eu-central-1`

maria (platform): do pins for acme and betacorp, and shift 80% back to v1 across eu-central. leave 20% v2 for telemetry. annotate the deploy issue and add incident tag INC-2026-42.


deploy-bot: executing tenant-pin and weight shift...

deploy-bot: tenant-pin complete: tenant:acme tenant:betacorp -> v1
deploy-bot: weight shift complete: v1=80% v2=20% in eu-central-1 (op-id=op-b1c2) :white_check_mark:

elaine (cs): pinged account managers for acme and betacorp. sending templated note: "We're temporarily routing your traffic to the v1 API while we patch a streaming edge-case in v2. ETA ~60-90m."

jen (ops): adding a gateway shim to strip trailing commas on the v2 path as a quick mitigation. will deploy to the 20% slice only.

tom (runtime): made a patch to the serializer to avoid trailing commas and added a unit test. PR: https://git/repo/pull/490. if merged I'll roll canary to the remaining 20%.

sriniv (sre): muting the streaming-error alert for the pinned tenants and the 20% v2 slice for 90m to avoid pages while we validate.

jen (ops): updated changelog: note mentions "temporary tenant pinning and streaming fix in progress". setting public status to "degraded" for eu region until we validate.

maria (platform): agreed plan. if PR merges and runtime tests pass, proceed: canary v2->5% then 25 then 100. if errors >0.3% at any step -> automatic rollback to v1 and schedule midnight full rollback if unresolved.

deploy-bot: checklist updated in deploy issue: `pins applied`, `shim deployed to 20%`, `sre mute set`, `cs messages sent`, `runtime pr open`

tom (runtime): merging PR now. will trigger CI. aiming to push a hotpatch within 30m.

maria (platform): I'll keep watch. tagging ops and sre for handoff at the 5% step. follow-up in 25m with status. :eyes:
